record.body: CELL1 R93 extended the canonical ggen-ecosystem-ocel-pack with 50 observation/qualification closure gates. Exact semantic head a3e2fd3f681b3f944eec8b77f5d116d7b3a7746a was reconciled onto concurrent current main 630da1b9f8371d4ec444cca917800b53025cba7f as fd340163b1423fd4c6598cde40b245d279f9f201; draft PR #340. The gates make O/Q/M evidence fail closed, enforce U>=G>=O>=Q>=M and U-M/G-O obligation arithmetic, and bind run/digest/event/object/causal identity. No new deterministic OCEL artifact was generated in this run, so the previously admitted digest remains unchanged-prior-artifact only: sha256:0b059d5edbffabba09dd7f17196d9c8686775ee351acf5e16cc81e5a95f7df51. No new O/Q/M is claimed. Fresh grounded execution of the new gates remains an observation obligation; exact-head CI and Vacuity are running.
